family_enrollment.subject: Thanks for reaching out to ClearCode Reading Center
paragraphs: Thank you for telling us about your child. I know reaching out can feel like a big step, and I'm glad you did.

I'm Bethany Fleming, Founder & CEO of ClearCode Reading Center. We're a structured literacy intervention center opening in the Orlando area in 2027, built for K–8 students who haven't yet reached grade-level reading proficiency. I started ClearCode because I believe every child can learn to read with the right method — and the earlier we start, the better.
I'd love to set up a short call to talk through your family's needs and answer any questions. To make this easy, grab a time on my calendar that works for you: {{scheduling_link}}
In the meantime, feel free to explore our website to learn more about our approach.

referral_partners.subject: Introducing ClearCode Reading Center
paragraphs: I'm Bethany Fleming, Founder & CEO of ClearCode Reading Center. We're a structured literacy intervention center opening in the Orlando area in 2027, working with K–8 students who are struggling to read.

Our approach is built on a simple belief: every child can learn to read with the right method, and the earlier we intervene, the more we prevent years of struggle and lost confidence. We combine evidence-based structured literacy instruction with a model designed to scale, so more families can access this kind of support, not just the ones who happen to find the right tutor.
I think {{company.name}} and ClearCode could be a strong referral fit — your work with families likely surfaces exactly the kids we're built to help.
Would you be open to a short call so we can share more? In the meantime, check out our website to learn more about our approach.

foundation_donors.subject: An invitation to learn about ClearCode Reading Center
paragraphs: Thank you so much for your interest in ClearCode Foundation! We are the nonprofit arm of ClearCode Reading Center, a structured literacy intervention center opening in Central Florida in 2027 whose mission is to make sure every K–8th grade student that hasn't yet reached grade-level reading proficiency has a path to becoming a confident reader, regardless of a family's ability to pay.
I'd love to connect with you. May I call you sometime this week?

foundation_grants.subject: Introduction request: ClearCode Foundation
paragraphs: I'm reaching out on behalf of the ClearCode Foundation, a non-profit that funds scholarships for literacy interventions for qualifying families and other community focused literacy initiatives. I understand {{company.name}} has supported work in this space, and I'd welcome the chance to introduce our program.
Would you be open to a short call, or could you point me to the right person on your team?
